policies.year_basis_zh: 签署年份（多数职业承认他州执照）。

policies.definition_en: Statewide statute (not a city rule, pilot or regulator decision) creating a regulatory framework for Transportation Network Companies (Uber/Lyft): authorises TNC operation with permit or registration, insurance and driver-vetting rules, typically pre-empting local rules.
policies.definition_zh: 州级成文法为网约车平台（TNC，如Uber/Lyft）建立全州监管框架：合法化其运营并规定许可或登记、保险与司机审查，通常排除地方自行立法。
policies.year_basis_en: Year the first statewide framework statute was signed; insurance-only and local rules not counted.
policies.year_basis_zh: 首部全州框架法的签署年份；纯保险立法与地方规则不计。
policies.labor_topic_en: Gig-economy entry, driver earnings and taxi-market effects
policies.labor_topic_zh: 零工经济进入、司机收入与出租车市场冲击

policies.definition_en: Statewide mandate requiring private employers to provide paid sick leave; year the mandate first took effect for covered employers (city/county-only, temporary COVID-only and any-purpose PTO laws excluded).

policies.year_basis_en: Year the statewide mandate first took effect.
policies.year_basis_zh: 全州强制规定首次生效的年份。
policies.labor_topic_en: Paid sick days, job retention and worker health

policies.definition_en: Year in which a state-run paid family (and medical) leave insurance program first began paying benefits (not when contributions began); states with no program, or whose benefits were not yet payable by 2025-12-31, are null.
policies.definition_zh: 各州设立的带薪家庭与医疗假保险项目首次开始支付待遇的年份（以待遇可领取而非开始缴费为准），截至2025年底尚无项目或待遇尚未发放的州为空。
policies.year_basis_en: Year the program first paid benefits (not when contributions began).

policies.definition_en: State statute prohibiting private employers from asking job applicants about their salary history (typically also from relying on it to set pay); year the law took effect. Public-employer-only orders and city ordinances are excluded.
policies.definition_zh: 州法律禁止（私营）雇主询问求职者的薪资历史（通常也禁止据此定薪）；年份为该法对私营雇主生效的年份，仅适用于政府部门的行政令及城市条例不计入。
policies.year_basis_en: Year the ban took effect for private employers.
policies.year_basis_zh: 禁令对私营雇主生效的年份。
policies.labor_topic_en: Pay transparency and the gender and racial wage gap
policies.labor_topic_zh: 薪酬透明与性别、种族工资差距

policies.definition_en: Statewide statute or voter-approved ballot measure setting a scheduled path to a $15 (or higher) hourly state minimum wage for most employers (phase-in, employer-size and regional tiers allowed). CPI-indexing-only states and city/county-only $15 laws are excluded.
policies.definition_zh: 全州范围内通过法律或选民公投设定的、对多数雇主分步提高至 15 美元（或更高）州最低时薪的时间表（允许分阶段，以及按雇主规模或地区分档）；仅靠通胀指数化的州以及仅市县层面的 15 美元法律不计入。
policies.year_basis_en: Year the law or ballot measure setting a path to a $15 minimum wage was enacted.
policies.year_basis_zh: 设定15美元最低工资路径的法律（或公投）的颁布年份。
policies.labor_topic_en: Employment and wage effects of higher wage floors
policies.labor_topic_zh: 更高工资下限对就业与工资的影响
